autoclub.name: Auto Club Speedway (Fontana)
credits: vhr_auto-club-speedway v2.1: VHR StockCar Ovals by Rainmaker (from CorvetteDave's rFactor track)
autoclub.description: Auto Club Speedway in Fontana, California - the 2-mile D-oval, in its own spot in the track list. Races for every series: Cup 'California 400', O'Reilly 'Inland Empire 300', Truck 'Fontana 200' and ARCA 'Fontana 150'. Use Career races to put it into your career.

freecam.name: Free Cam
freecam.description: Free camera in races. F5 = free cam with the race (and your car) frozen, F6 = free cam with the race running, I/J/K/L = look; press the same key again to go back. Loaded automatically by the mods loader. Logs to Binaries\Win64\FreeCam.log. If F5 does nothing after a game update, check FreeCam.log (it needs a rebuild against the new build).

manager.notes: Tools > Check for updates: checks the Mod Manager and your installed mods, with a result message; updates are seen right after they're published.
